race.title: JDA Grand Design Mares' Handicap Chase
race.verdict: This looks a good chance for GATA BAN to land a third success of the season. With doubts about Out On Her Own 's stamina over 3m it could be that the class-dropping Princess Keri , who shaped better than the result on her reappearance, gives Neil Mulholland's charge most to do. GATA BAN (IRE) PRINCESS KERI (IRE) OUT ON HER OWN
race.bettingForecast: Gata Ban (5/4), Out On Her Own (13/8), Kit's Coty (5/1), Princess Keri (10/1), Walkingtheline (33/1)
